_comment: Pre-registers the control plane's database in pgAdmin so a fresh container is not an
empty console. Host is the compose service name, not localhost: pgAdmin connects across
the compose network, where 5432 is the container's own port and the published loopback
No password is stored here — pgAdmin prompts on first connect and can then save it.
If JDBC_USER or JDBC_DATABASE is overridden in compose, edit Username/MaintenanceDB to
match, or just correct them in the UI.

1.Name: systmone control plane
1.Comment: Run history, audit log and the element registry (NFR-CMP-03).
